title: Highly scented
text: Highly scented. I purchased this a few months back and have yet to line my drawers.  The product is sitting in my garage until the scent tampers down enough that I can bring it into a home with someone who has Asthma.  It's pretty.

product_metadata.title: Scentennials Scented Drawer Liners - Floral Print - 18 Sheets 16.5 x 22 Inch Non-Adhesive - Perfect for Closet Shelves and Dresser Drawers (Green Tea & Lemon)
features: COMPATIBLE WITH ANY KIND OF DECOR - This lovely soft and pleasant floral design is a charming addition to decor already in your lovely home. A luxurious yet practical addition to your boudoir or bedroom dresser drawers

WONDERFUL LONG LASTING SCENT - Top notes of bergamot, lemon and garden mint. Mid notes of green tea, rose and cyclamen. Base notes of lily, amber, moss and violet. Using our paper fragrance process the scent softly diffuses slowly over time as it is exposed to the air.

KEEPS CLOTHES AND LINENS SMELLING FRESH - These fragrance infused shelf and drawer liners keep your clothes smelling pleasant and fresh. You'll love pulling your clothes out of the dresser each day. These drawer liner papers keep your clothes, lingerie, towels, and bedroom linens smelling fresh and clean.
BEAUTIFUL PACKAGING - Each set of Scentennials Scented Drawer Liners is delivered in a matching gift box that can be kept as a keepsake. Makes a wonderful gift for friends and family members

6, 12 or 18 SHEETS IN A SINGLE BOX - Contains 6, 12 or 18 16.5 x 22 inch non-adhesive paper sheets for your home's drawers and shelves. Can easily be cut to the size, and are perfect to use as shelf liners in your linen closet or to freshen that musty vintage cabinet
